# Repository agent guide

KairoECS is a Rust-native discrete-event and agent-based simulation library with
multiple language bindings. Keep engine contracts, replay determinism, and
security boundaries explicit in every change.

## Start here

- Read `README.md` and `CONTRIBUTING.md` for project workflow and contribution rules.
- Read `SECURITY.md` before changing CI, dependencies, FFI, publishing, or artifact handling.
- Use `conductor/workflow.md`, `conductor/track-map.md`, and `conductor/tracks.yaml` to find the active owner and acceptance gates.
- Check `conductor/subagents.md` and the selected track's `spec.md`, `plan.md`, and `test-matrix.md` before changing owned paths.

## Change and validation rules

- Keep patches within the selected track's ownership contract; hand off before crossing owners.
- Preserve deterministic scheduling and shared conformance contracts. Public API, ABI, schema, or fixture changes require the review steps in `CONTRIBUTING.md`.
- Run `just ci` as the one-command Rust validation lane. It uses one coverage-instrumented workspace test pass, checks the core coverage floor, and runs formatting, lint, docs, and dependency policy checks.
- Run `just quality-drift` for a fresh read-only GitHub settings/source readback. It writes `artifacts/quality-frontier-drift.json`; `pass`, `drift`, `pending`, and `unavailable` remain distinct, and non-pass results exit nonzero.
- For a narrower change, run the smallest relevant validator and report skipped checks. A local pass is not evidence of a hosted Actions run or release acceptance.
- Record command, working directory, commit, toolchain, deterministic seed/input hash where applicable, exit status, and artifact path for validation claims.
- Keep secrets and private vulnerability details out of source and public CI artifacts. Do not publish packages, create releases, or change protected branch settings as an implicit consequence of a passing test.

# C4.2 cohort and window contract v1

Coordinator-reviewed extension of c4.2-runtime-contract-v1. Private Rust types only, no wire/public API or inference. src/metric_cohorts.rs delegates every W1/KS computation to metrics::compare.

Reference and simulation input share an explicit cohort identity (dataset, endpoint, unit, mapping version, seed schedule and seed map). Mixed identities are invalid. Source-evidence verification is an explicit precondition: unverified inputs produce Unverified/null, never computed. No patient data, source-derived strata or inferred provenance.

Record logical keys are unique per side, fixed group names are declared before comparison, and all fixed groups emit a result including empty groups. Windows are optional half-open [start,end) over explicit observed/source selection_time, not predicted or support value. Invalid window bounds, duplicate keys/groups, unknown groups or contradictory primary outcomes fail closed. Missing selection time is excluded under source_window.v1 and counted missing; it is never supplied from prediction.

Outcome is Point, Missing, Censored, Failed or Infeasible, with Point requiring a value and other outcomes requiring null. Independent diagnostic flags may overlap point counts or one another; valid point predictions flagged infeasible remain points unless the explicit exclusion rule excludes them. Count raw instances, excluded instances, censor/missing/failure/infeasibility diagnostics separately; W1/KS unpaired unmatched is always zero. Numeric contributing point counts come from kernel results, not raw attempts; whole-comparison invalid results have zero numeric counts. Keep raw and exclusion diagnostics even when no metric exists.

Sort contributing records by stable logical key before handing supports/weights to exact kernel; kernel sorts numeric support and aggregates ties. Equal-weight requests reject explicit weights; weighted requests require weight for each input point. Non-point rows have no implicit weight mass. Unit, scale, algorithm and optional exact common origin are fixed in spec. Coverage counts and warnings are adapter semantics, not public calibration_metric.v1 serialization. No survival adjustment, p-values or uncertainty. Independent permutation/window/identity/invalid/coverage tests and actual-source integration review gate acceptance.

# C4.2 private runtime contract v1

Coordinator-approved bounded implementation under accepted ADR-0005 placement and C0.2 residual/metric semantics. Owner 21; owner 12 test-only conformance adapter. Implements C4.2 only; no public Rust API, Arrow, scheduler, dependencies or seed changes. Private modules remain experimental; C4.3 encoding and C4.4/C-04 phase acceptance stay separate.

## Exact distance kernel

`src/metrics.rs` exposes only crate-private items. Frozen adapter entry:

```rust
pub(crate) fn compare(request: &MetricRequest<'_>) -> MetricResult;
pub(crate) struct MetricRequest<'a> {
    pub reference: &'a [Option<&'a str>],
    pub simulation: &'a [Option<&'a str>],
    pub reference_weights: Option<&'a [&'a str]>,
    pub simulation_weights: Option<&'a [&'a str]>,
    pub algorithm_version: &'a str,
    pub origin: Option<&'a str>,
    pub scale_ticks: &'a str,
}
pub(crate) enum MetricStatus { Computed, Empty, InsufficientData, Invalid }
pub(crate) enum Precision { NotApplicable, ExactOffsets, Rejected }
pub(crate) struct MetricResult {
    pub status: MetricStatus,
    pub w1: Option<f64>, pub ks_d: Option<f64>,
    pub reference_count: usize, pub simulation_count: usize,
    pub precision: Precision,
}
```

Support strings are declared unit values; optional origin makes them absolute unsigned u128 ticks. Decimal/rational parsing retains exact signed magnitude and positive denominator, with gcd normalization and checked u128 arithmetic; no rounded CDFs. All ties aggregate before right-continuous CDF gap. Equal counts or exact nonnegative rational weights normalize each side independently. W1 sum and KS maximum use checked exact rational arithmetic and convert only at final output; tick W1 divides by positive exact scale once. Common origin subtraction is checked before any float conversion; every tick offset must be exactly binary64-representable (bit length/trailing zeros), including full-u128 values. Rational magnitude/denominator and checked reduced intermediates are bounded to u128: representational overflow returns Invalid/null, never wraps, silently rounds or introduces a float fallback. Finite JSON output required. Record this bounded arithmetic limitation explicitly; no arbitrary-precision promise. Algorithm names consume empirical_equal.v1 and weighted_descriptive.v1. No KS inference/p-value.

Validate raw weight length and every raw weight before dropping aligned null supports or classifying empty. Zero-weight observations retain point counts. Nonempty populations require positive finite mass; unknown algorithm, malformed/nonfinite support/weight, negative/zero-total weight and incompatible scale produce invalid/null/zero metric counts. Nulls remain missing. Both eligible populations empty => Empty; one empty => InsufficientData. Valid origin input => ExactOffsets; origin/preprocessing errors => Rejected; ordinary invalid support cases => NotApplicable. Coverage metadata belongs to the adapter, not distance kernel.

## Paired residuals and fixed strata/windows

`src/residuals.rs` is private, with exact unsigned-u128 sign/magnitude point residuals: predicted minus observed, no signed-i128 cast. Pair REFERENCE observed endpoint rows against SIMULATION unclamped point predictions using the complete C0.2 logical tuple (study/dataset/scenario/schedule/replication/case/task/occurrence/endpoint/purpose/map/mapping), excluding candidate/run IDs. This is prediction error, not a difference of two candidate residuals. Duplicates or contradictory provenance/status inputs are invalid; unsupported provenance is unverified. Failure/censor/missing/infeasible outcomes retain explicit statuses and nullable values. Never clamp or impute. A valid point prediction may independently be infeasible or late.

Declare fixed endpoint, externally supplied strata and optional [start,end) window on observed/source selection time. Selection time is an explicit field distinct from predicted ticks and may be present for censored/missing rows; never substitute prediction for absent selection time. Reject invalid windows or mixed unit/endpoint/mapping/schedule cohorts. Explicit prespecified groups emit empty results. Records outside window/excluded by declared rule remain counted. Overlapping excluded/censored/missing/failed/infeasible diagnostics are independent, not additive. Unmatched counts include input records without an eligible valid numeric counterpart, once per side. Preserve all primary status-bearing rows in output.

Equal-weight summary semantics residual_summary.canonical_float.v1: signed mean (bias), MAE, RMSE over matched computed errors only; ascending logical key reduction, deterministic compensated float sums after exact sign/magnitude computation. Values are descriptive binary64 summaries, not exact ticks; flag approximation when u128 magnitudes lose exact float precision. Nonfinite reduction is invalid/null; no p-values/uncertainty. Individual residual signs/magnitudes always exact and output ticks are never modified. Both eligible point populations empty => Empty; no valid pairs with any point population => InsufficientData. All noncomputed statuses return null summaries. Explicit no pairing/provenance support => Unverified/null. Window/group counts and rows remain present on noncomputed output.

## Test-only actual runtime producer

`tests/metrics_c42.rs` path-imports exact private metrics source. It reads ONLY fixture IDs/input, never expected or reference outputs. Computes all distance values via compare and independently computes coverage/conditional metadata from raw inputs. Schema c41.candidate.v1 retains existing comparator fields, sorted versions and source-bound provenance kind runtime_candidate, actual forty-hex producer commit, toolchain and producer API path. Optional C42_REPORT_PATH writes the actual report; C42_PRODUCER_COMMIT binds run source. Root executes existing ignored c42_candidate_report explicitly against that report and runs Python independent comparator too. A metadata claim alone is insufficient: source hashes, actual execution logs and producer review retained.

No frozen C4.1 fixture/reference/comparator changes or weaker tolerances. Add behavioral unit tests first and retain initial missing-implementation failure. Unit tests prove edge/overflow/permutation behavior; final exact runtime report must pass all 42 frozen cases. Default native CI exercises actual producer even without external report output. Root integrates modules in lib.rs serially. Worker scope: one source module each or one test adapter file, plus explicit ignored receipts path; no Cargo/lock/core/DES/Arrow/CI changes. Full calibration/current strict lint and Rust 1.88 tests at integration; benchmark sorted reduction on representative synthetic populations with evidence, no speedup promise. Independent review required before checkbox/pin publication.

authority: Source material only; task approval, ownership and acceptance remain separate.
